execution_order: One attempt per arm. Rotate six pool/policy combinations by case index. Two cases concurrently, each case six arms sequentially. No best-of, hidden retry or prompt revision after outcomes.
retrieval_policy: Replay the prior real initial retrieval and prior selector repetition0. All forty pool passages provide canonical seed handles. Empty selections remain empty. Initial replay consumes one shared search slot, including the two-search RRF pool. All arms subsequently use full-history default local BM25 with passage_chars2048, no new edges or journals. Initial skipped-owner lists are empty in both policies.
latency_policy: Import and prebuild the common follow-up BM25 index before six arms. Retain per-trial validation/application wall time and runtime usage timings. Historical selector latency is additional simulated pipeline overhead, not a new measurement. Prior retrieval latency and GPU build costs are excluded from new answer latency.
accuracy_policy: All24 LongMemEval questions, including both four-annotated-source cases. Pinned official task prompts and Chat Completions gpt4o snapshot temperature0,max_tokens10. Strict yes/no parser, not unmodified upstream evaluator. Controlled8 use adapted multi-session or abstention rubric, scored separately.
support_policy: Independent blinded structured-output judge sees only question/date, actual final answer, canonical cited text, roles and dates. No gold or arm labels. Require support of material factual claims and correct temporal/entity/attribution use. Pure abstention is not_applicable and separate from factual supported accuracy.
cost_policy: Dated synchronous token estimates from actual provider usage, with cached input counted once. Before each call, reserve uncached cost from UTF8 message/schema bytes plus2048 framing and full output cap. Shared concurrent reservations, unknown usage retained at bound, stop on bound breach or16 unknown-usage calls. These are local admission controls, not provider billing caps. Current generation, judging and historical selector estimates reported separately.
claims: Exposed diagnostic cohort, shared benchmark histories and templated controls. One answer per arm does not identify small stochastic effects. Compare selection policies within each pool. This does not establish held-out accuracy, learned graph quality, standalone BM25 versus ColBERT superiority, real hybrid retrieval latency, or billed cloud cost.
